reference_policy: Written brief only; no private example image is a target. VLM internal weights: instruction following 60%, aesthetics 40%.
focus: Golf: three parallel continuous green lanes with raised rails, recessed cups/flags at rounded far ends and start balls beside common path. Left windmill and middle castle provide actual ball-passable arch openings. Each lane has one diamond obstacle with space around it. Cream/terracotta sunny stylization; dynamic ball simulation not required.

anchors.0: Absent, wholly wrong, or no visible evidence of the required result; no credit.
anchors.1: Weak resemblance/fulfilment (about one quarter); major omissions or pervasive defects.
anchors.2: Partial (about half); recognizable intent but material errors in key requirements or visual quality.
anchors.3: Mostly correct (about three quarters); concrete remaining discrepancies prevent excellent credit.
anchors.4: Excellent: all important visible requirements satisfied, coherent and polished, no material discrepancy. Requires explicit positive evidence, not merely lack of reported faults.
